summary: Wholesale Pricing Feature - Cart and Checkout Bug Fixes VERIFIED. All 11 tests now pass. Fixed missing useEffect import in Cart.js and corrected Checkout.js to use getDisplayPrice() instead of item.product.price for wholesale price display.

bugs_fixed.issue: Missing useEffect import - Cart.js was using useEffect on line 31 but only had 'import React from react' without importing useEffect. This would cause the Cart page to crash.
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed 'import React from react' to 'import React, { useEffect } from react'

bugs_fixed.issue: One-time items display section (lines 501-524) was using item.product.price directly instead of getDisplayPrice() for wholesale price display. While the total calculation was correct using getWholesaleCartTotal(), the displayed unit prices showed retail instead of wholesale.
bugs_fixed.fix: Updated to use getDisplayPrice(item.product) and isShowingWholesale(item.product) with BadgePercent icon for WP indicator
